blocks.prompt: 4 A cyclist travelled 48 km at a uniform speed. If he had travelled 2 km/hour slower, he would have taken 2 hours more to perform the journey. How long did he take to cover 48 km?
blocks.explanation:
Yeh speed aur time ka word problem hai. Bunyadi formula: time \(=\) distance \(\div\) speed.
Diya kya hai? Cyclist ne 48 km ek jaisi speed se tay kiye; 2 km/h aahista chalta to 2 ghante zyada lagte.
Find kya karna hai? 48 km mein kitna waqt laga.
Plan: speed \(v\) maan kar dono times likhenge, "2 ghante zyada" se equation, speed nikalenge, phir time.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: faasla 48 km; speed 2 km/h kam ho to 2 ghante zyada.
Humein find karna hai: laga hua waqt.
Tareeqa: Time \(= \frac{\text{distance}}{\text{speed}}\). Misaal: 60 km, 30 km/h ki speed se, 2 ghante. Speed ko unknown rakhna aasaan hai, kyunke dono soorton ki speed \(v\) aur \(v - 2\) seedhi likh sakte hain. Pehle speed niklegi, phir us se time.

Unknown chunein aur dono times likhein
\[\text{Let speed} = v \text{ km/h}\]
\[\text{time} = \dfrac{48}{v}\]
\[\text{slower time} = \dfrac{48}{v - 2}\]
Kyun: Aahista speed \(v - 2\) par wohi 48 km zyada waqt lete hain, is liye doosra time bara hai.

Equation banayen
\[\dfrac{48}{v - 2} - \dfrac{48}{v} = 2\]
Kyun: "2 ghante zyada" ka matlab: aahista wala time minus asal time \(= 2\). Bara time pehle likha taake farq positive aaye.

Fractions khatam karein
\[48v - 48(v - 2) = 2v(v - 2)\]
\[96 = 2v^2 - 4v\]
Kyun: LCD \(v(v - 2)\) se multiply kiya. Left par \(48v - 48v + 96 = 96\).
Dhyan dein: \(-48(v - 2) = -48v + 96\); minus ko bracket ke andar dono terms par lagana hai.

Standard form aur factorization
\[v^2 - 2v - 48 = 0\]
\[(v - 8)(v + 6) = 0\]
\[v = 8 \text{ or } v = -6\]
Kyun: 2 se divide kiya. Product \(-48\) aur sum \(-2\) wale numbers \(-8\) aur \(6\) hain. Speed negative nahi ho sakti, is liye \(v = 8\) km/h.

Time nikalein
\[\text{time} = \dfrac{48}{8} = 6 \text{ hours}\]
Kyun: Sawal time poochh raha hai, speed nahi. Aksar bachay \(v = 8\) likh kar ruk jate hain; aakhri jawab time hona chahiye.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{48}{6} = 8 \text{ hours at } 6 \text{ km/h}\]
\[8 - 6 = 2 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: 2 km/h aahista (6 km/h) par safar 8 ghante ka hota, jo 6 se theek 2 ghante zyada hai. Dono shartein poori: 8 km/h par 6 ghante mein 48 km, aur 6 km/h par 8 ghante mein bhi 48 km. Is tarah check karne se pata chal jata hai ke equation sahi banayi thi.
